chapter_en: Chapter 38: Going to call on a noble

units.chapter_en: Chapter 38: Going to call on a noble
units.title: 趋谒贵人：以世应为主、外卦月卦为凭；外卦原来是用爻，兴隆出现得相交，无身无鬼皆非遇；凡去谒贵最嫌外卦空亡，外卦出现旺相人必相逢，外三爻皆动定有变更，一二爻动亦不如此论、又要取卦身与鬼官之爻，如缺一神又不遇

rule.yi: 去谒见贵人，以世爻、应爻为主，以外卦、月卦为凭据。外卦本来就是用爻：兴旺并且出现，就能相会；没有卦身、没有官鬼，都见不到。凡是去谒见贵人，最嫌外卦空亡；外卦出现而且旺相，人一定能见到；如果外卦三个爻都动，一定有变更；一、二个爻动，不这样论，还要取卦身和官鬼之爻，缺了其中一个，又见不到。
rule.en: In going to call on a noble, take the Self and the Other as the chief, and the outer trigram and the month hexagram as the ground. The outer trigram is originally the Subject line: if it flourishes and appears, one gets to meet; with no Body and no Pressure, one does not meet. In every call on a noble, what is most disliked is the outer trigram falling on Void; if the outer trigram appears and is thriving, one will surely meet the person; if all three lines of the outer trigram move, there will surely be a change; if one or two lines move, it is not judged so, but one must also take the Body and the Pressure line, and if one of these is lacking, one again does not meet.

zh: 以世应为主，外卦月卦为凭。
yi: 以世爻、应爻为主要看的，以外卦、月卦为凭据。
en: Take the Self and the Other as the chief to be looked at, and the outer trigram and the month hexagram as the ground.

zh: 外卦原来是用爻，兴隆出现得相交，无身无鬼皆非遇，
yi: 外卦本来就是用爻，兴旺而且出现，就能相会；没有卦身、没有官鬼，都不能遇到；
en: The outer trigram is originally the Subject line; if it flourishes and appears, one gets to meet; with no Body and no Pressure, in neither case does one meet;

zh: 凡去谒贵，最嫌外卦空亡，若得外卦出现旺相，人必相逢。
如外三爻皆动，定有变更。
一二爻动，亦不如此论，又要取卦身与鬼官之爻，如缺一神又不遇也。
yi: 凡是去谒见贵人，最嫌外卦空亡；如果外卦出现而且旺相，人一定相逢。
如果外卦三个爻都动，一定有变更。
一、二个爻动的，也不这样论，还要取卦身和官鬼之爻；缺了其中一个，又见不到。
en: In every call on a noble, what is most disliked is the outer trigram falling on Void; if the outer trigram appears and is thriving, one will surely meet the person.
If all three lines of the outer trigram move, there will surely be a change.
If one or two lines move, it is not judged so; one must also take the Body and the Pressure line, and if one of these is lacking, one again does not meet.

note.yi: 谒见贵人时，外卦代表被拜见的一方（按本章后文「内为主，外为宾」）。「月卦」书里没有解释，本章别处也没有再用，这里按字面译作「月卦」。「无身无鬼皆非遇」的「身」是卦身（见术语表）。「外三爻皆动，定有变更」是说外卦三爻齐动，所见的人或事有变，书里没有展开。「鬼官」是官鬼。这一条与易隐谒贵占「外卦与应爻官爻属阴在家、属阳出外」「动者难见空者不见」（YY.74、YY.75）取同一个象：外卦、应爻是被拜见的人。
note.en: In calling on a noble, the outer trigram stands for the party who is visited (by the chapter's later 'the inner is the host and the outer is the guest'). The book does not explain 'yuegua', the month hexagram, and the chapter does not use it again, so it is translated literally. The 'body' of 'with no Body and no Pressure one does not meet' is the Body of the hexagram (see the glossary). 'If all three lines of the outer trigram move there will surely be a change' says that when the three lines of the outer trigram all move, the person or the matter seen changes, and the book does not go into it. 'Guiguan' is Pressure. This entry takes the same image as 'the outer trigram and the Pressure line of the Other, if yin he is at home and if yang he is out' and 'if it moves he is hard to see, if Void he is not seen' in the Yi Yin divination on calling on a noble (YY.74, YY.75): the outer trigram and the Other are the person who is visited.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 38: Going to call on a noble
units.title: 趋谒贵人：主若伤宾情据抛；复看世为主应为宾、内为主外为宾，内外世应相生比和、应克世外克内皆主相逢得意，惟独世克应与内克外主反触宾纵然相见亦不相投

rule.yi: 主人如果伤了宾，情意就丢开了。再看世爻是主、应爻是宾，内卦是主、外卦是宾：内外卦、世应相生，或者比和，或者应克世、外克内，都主相逢称心；唯独世克应、内克外，主方反而冒犯宾方，即使见面，也不相投。
rule.en: If the host injures the guest, the feeling is thrown away. Look also at the Self as the host and the Other as the guest, and the inner as the host and the outer as the guest: if the inner and outer trigrams or the Self and the Other generate each other, or are in accord, or the Other controls the Self, or the outer controls the inner, in every case it means meeting to one's satisfaction; only if the Self controls the Other, or the inner controls the outer, does the host on the contrary offend the guest, and even if they meet they will not get on.

zh: 主若伤宾情据抛。
yi: 主方如果伤了宾方，情谊就被抛开了。
en: If the host injures the guest, the feeling is thrown away.

zh: 复看世为主，应为实。
又以内为主，外为实。
如遇内外世应相生、或比和、或应克世、外克内，皆主相逢得意也。
惟独世克应与内克外，主反触宾，纵然相见亦不相投。
yi: 再看世爻是主，应爻是宾。
又以内卦为主，外卦为宾。
如果遇到内外卦、世应相生，或者比和，或者应克世、外克内，都主相逢称意。
只有世克应和内克外，主方反而冒犯宾方，即使见面也不相投。
en: Look again at the Self as the host and the Other as the guest.
And take the inner as the host and the outer as the guest.

If the inner and outer trigrams or the Self and the Other generate each other, or are in accord, or the Other controls the Self, or the outer controls the inner, in every case it means meeting to one's satisfaction.
Only if the Self controls the Other, or the inner controls the outer, does the host on the contrary offend the guest, and even if they meet they will not get on.

note.yi: 「应为实」「外为实」的「实」疑是「宾」（诀里写「主若伤宾」，解末也写「触宾」），译作「宾」。这里的「主」是去拜访的一方（世、内），「宾」是被拜访的一方（应、外）。书里不说「应克世、外克内」为什么反而得意、「世克应、内克外」为什么反而触宾，只列了结果。
note.en: The 'shi' of 'ying wei shi' and 'wai wei shi' is presumably 'bin', guest (the verse says 'if the host injures the guest' and the end of the explanation says 'offends the guest'), and it is translated 'guest'. The 'host' here is the party who goes to call (the Self, the inner) and the 'guest' is the party who is called on (the Other, the outer). The book does not say why 'the Other controls the Self, the outer controls the inner' should on the contrary be satisfactory and 'the Self controls the Other, the inner controls the outer' should on the contrary offend the guest, and gives only the results.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 38: Going to call on a noble
units.title: 趋谒贵人：世临空地难成事、应落空亡白费劳，望客喜逢三合卦、见宾怕遇六冲爻；趋谒之事世应与官鬼皆莫空亡三者如有一空决不相得，纵不逢空若值六冲决无美意，若得三合六合之卦自然宾主相谐，应象交重谓人不遇

rule.yi: 世爻落在空地，事难成；应爻落到空亡，白费辛劳。拜访客人，喜欢遇到三合的卦；会见宾客，怕遇到六冲的爻。趋谒的事，世、应和官鬼都不要落空亡，这三个里如果有一个落空，一定彼此不合；即使不遇空，如果遇到六冲，也一定没有好意；如果得到三合、六合的卦，宾主自然和谐；如果应象又发动，就说是人不遇。
rule.en: If the Self falls on empty ground the matter is hard to accomplish; if the Other falls on Void the toil is wasted. In calling on a visitor one is glad to meet a three-harmony hexagram; in meeting a guest one fears a six-clash line. In a call on a noble, the Self, the Other and Pressure must none be Void; if one of the three is Void, the two will surely not agree; even if none is Void, if there is a six-clash there will surely be no good will; if the hexagram is a three-harmony or a six-combine, guest and host are naturally in accord; if the Other image moves as well, it is said that the person is not met.

zh: 世临空地难成事，应落空亡白费劳。
望客喜逢三合卦，见宾怕遇六冲爻。
yi: 世爻落在空地，事情难成；应爻落到空亡，白费辛劳。
拜访客人，喜欢遇到三合的卦；会见宾客，怕遇到六冲的爻。
en: If the Self falls on empty ground the matter is hard to accomplish; if the Other falls on Void the toil is wasted.
In calling on a visitor one is glad to meet a three-harmony hexagram; in meeting a guest one fears a six-clash line.

zh: 趋谒之事，世应与官鬼皆莫空亡，三者如有一空，决不相得，纵不逢空，若值六冲，决无美意。
若得三合六合之卦，自然宾主相谐，若还应象交重，谓人不遇。
yi: 趋谒的事，世、应和官鬼都不要落空亡，这三个里如果有一个落空，一定彼此不合；即使不遇空，如果遇到六冲，也一定没有好意。
如果得到三合、六合的卦，宾主自然和谐；如果应象又发动，就说是人不遇。
en: In a call on a noble, the Self, the Other and Pressure must none be Void; if one of the three is Void, the two will surely not agree; even if none is Void, if it meets a six-clash there will surely be no good will.
If the hexagram is a three-harmony or a six-combine, guest and host are naturally in accord; if the Other image moves as well, it is said that the person is not met.

note.yi: 「望客」「见宾」都是去拜访。「三合」是三合局，「六合」「六冲」是卦的六合、六冲（见术语表）。「应象交重」是应爻发动（「交重」是动爻的记号）；「谓人不遇」是说要见的人不在、见不到。这一条与易隐谒贵占「动者难见，空者不见；……六合见，六冲不见」（YY.75）取同一类象。
note.en: 'Wangke' and 'jianbin' both mean going to call. 'Three-harmony' is the three-harmony formation, and 'six-combine' and 'six-clash' are the hexagram patterns (see the glossary). 'Ying xiang jiaozhong' is the Other line moving ('jiaozhong' is the mark of a moving line); 'wei ren bu yu' says that the person to be seen is not in and cannot be seen. This entry takes the same kind of images as 'if it moves he is hard to see, if Void he is not seen; ... with a six-combine one sees him, with a six-clash one does not' in the Yi Yin divination on calling on a noble (YY.75).

units.chapter_en: Chapter 38: Going to call on a noble
units.title: 趋谒贵人：如求书贴忧财发偏宜父母值重交，或去解非并脱讼子孙爻动祸殃消，若还觅利抽丰者财官两旺乐滔滔；求文取帖送书递柬不宜父母空亡更忌妻财发动，解词息讼反宜官鬼休囚又怕应来伤世，假公济私或抽丰利己须财官两旺切嫌兄弟交重

rule.yi: 去求书信、帖文，忧的是财爻发动，偏宜父母爻发动；去排解是非、脱出官司，子孙爻动，祸殃就消；求利、打抽丰，财爻、官爻两旺，就乐得很。具体说：去求文、取帖，以及送书、递柬，不适宜父母爻空亡，更忌妻财发动；想排解词讼、平息官司，反而适宜官鬼休囚，又怕应爻来伤世爻；遇到子孙持世或发动，祸一定消散；如果借公事来成全私情、或者打抽丰对自己有利，必须财、官两旺，切忌兄弟发动。
rule.en: If one seeks a letter or a note, one worries about Wealth moving and it is fitting for Resource to move; if one goes to settle a dispute or escape a lawsuit, when the Output line moves calamity is dispelled; if one seeks gain by drawing a rich man's bounty, Wealth and the star of office both thriving make one overflow with joy. In detail: in going to ask for a text or take a note, and in sending a letter or handing in a card, it is not fitting for Resource to be Void, and still more Wealth moving is avoided; if one wants to clear up a dispute and stop a lawsuit, it is on the contrary fitting for Pressure to be resting or imprisoned, and one fears the Other coming to hurt the Self; if Output holds the Self or moves, the calamity will surely vanish; if one makes use of a public affair to serve a private feeling, or draws a bounty for one's own benefit, Wealth and the star of office must both be thriving, and Peer moving is by all means to be avoided.

zh: 如求书贴忧财发，偏宜父母值重交，
或去解非并脱讼，子孙爻动祸殃消。
若还觅利抽丰者，财官两旺乐滔滔。
yi: 如果去求书信、帖文，忧的是财爻发动，偏偏适宜父母爻发动；
或者去排解是非、脱出官司，子孙爻动，祸殃就消；
如果是求利、打抽丰，财爻、官爻两旺，就乐得很。
en: If one seeks a letter or a note, one worries about Wealth moving and it is fitting for Resource to move;
if one goes to settle a dispute or escape a lawsuit, when the Output line moves calamity is dispelled;
if one seeks gain by drawing a rich man's bounty, Wealth and the star of office both thriving make one overflow with joy.

zh: 但去求文取帖及送书递柬，不宜父母空亡，更忌妻财发动，如要解词息讼，反宜官鬼休囚，又怕应来伤世。
若遇子孙持世或发动，祸必触消。
如去假公事以济私情，或抽丰而利己者，须得财官两旺，切嫌兄弟交重。
yi: 只要是去求文、取帖，以及送书、递柬，不适宜父母爻空亡，更忌妻财发动；如果要排解词讼、平息官司，反而适宜官鬼休囚，又怕应爻来伤世爻。
如果遇到子孙持世或发动，祸一定消散。
如果是借公事来成全私情，或者打抽丰对自己有利，必须财、官两旺，切忌兄弟发动。
en: For going to ask for a text or take a note, and for sending a letter or handing in a card, it is not fitting for Resource to be Void, and still more Wealth moving is avoided; if one wants to clear up a dispute and stop a lawsuit, it is on the contrary fitting for Pressure to be resting or imprisoned, and one fears the Other coming to hurt the Self.
If Output holds the Self or moves, the calamity will surely vanish.

If one makes use of a public affair to serve a private feeling, or draws a bounty for one's own benefit, Wealth and the star of office must both be thriving, and Peer moving is by all means to be avoided.

note.yi: 「书贴」是书信、帖文；「解非脱讼」是排解是非、脱出官司；「打抽丰」是去拜访有钱有势的人，求他资助；「递柬」是递送名帖。「祸必触消」的「触」疑是「顿」，译作「一定消散」。解词息讼时官鬼休囚反而好。这一条与易隐谒贵占「所求不同用神不同」（YY.77）取同一个法：求书恳荐以父母为用，息讼以子孙为用，各看各的。
note.en: 'Shutie' are letters and notes; 'jiefei tuosong' is settling a dispute and getting out of a lawsuit; 'da chou feng' is calling on a rich and powerful man to ask for his help; 'dijian' is handing in a visiting card. The 'chu' of 'huo bi chu xiao' is presumably 'dun', at once, and it is translated 'will surely vanish'. In clearing up a dispute and stopping a lawsuit, Pressure being resting or imprisoned is on the contrary good. This entry takes the same method as 'what is sought differs, the Subject differs' in the Yi Yin divination on calling on a noble (YY.77): for asking for a letter of recommendation Resource is the Subject, for stopping a lawsuit Output is the Subject, and each is looked at on its own.
